---
title: "Before Session 2: Git setup"
subtitle: "Complete before class"
---

## 1. Verify Git

The following commands are one-time setup checks, not syntax to memorize.

In the RStudio Terminal, run:

```bash
git --version
```

Copy the output. If the command is not recognized, install Git and restart RStudio.

## 2. Configure your identity

Use the name you want recorded in commit history:

```bash
git config --global user.name "Your Name"
git config --global user.email "your.email@example.edu"
```

Verify:

```bash
git config --global --list
```

Do not place a password or access token in these commands.

## 3. Verify RStudio integration

In RStudio, open **Tools → Global Options → Git/SVN** and confirm that a Git
executable is detected. Then open the root `BIOS6301-materials.Rproj` in your
course clone and confirm that the **Git** tab appears.

## 4. Prepare HTTPS browser authentication

This course uses HTTPS repository URLs. GitHub does **not** accept your account
password for Git pushes. We use a credential helper that opens GitHub in a
browser and then stores the resulting credential securely.

### Windows

Current Git for Windows includes Git Credential Manager. Verify it in the
RStudio Terminal:

```bash
git credential-manager --version
```

If the command is unavailable, update Git for Windows using the official
installer and accept its default Git Credential Manager option.

### macOS or Linux

Use Git Credential Manager if it is already provided by your system. Otherwise,
install [GitHub CLI](https://cli.github.com/) and run:

```bash
gh auth login
```

Choose **GitHub.com**, **HTTPS**, **Yes** when asked to authenticate Git, and
**Login with a web browser**. Do not create or paste a personal access token for
this course setup.

Sign in to the GitHub account approved for the course. Never save a credential
in an R script, Quarto document, repository, or remote URL.

## 5. Create an empty private repository

On GitHub, create a private repository such as `BIOS6301-mywork`. Do not add a
README, `.gitignore`, or license. We will connect the existing course clone to
this empty repository during class so that its original history is preserved.

Have its HTTPS URL available. It should have this form, without brackets or
parentheses:

```text
https://github.com/YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME/BIOS6301-mywork.git
```

Do not paste credentials into the URL or any course file.

Do not initialize a repository inside `work/`; the course clone is already the
repository.

## 6. Submit the check

Submit the output from:

```bash
git --version
git config user.name
git config user.email
```

You may obscure part of the email address in a public discussion post.
